name: token-usage-monitor
description: Development commands for the native Token Usage Monitor macOS app.

scripts.build: npm run project:generate && xcodebuild build -project TokenUsageMonitor.xcodeproj -scheme TokenUsageMonitor -destination 'platform=macOS,arch=arm64' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.test: npm run project:generate && xcodebuild test -project TokenUsageMonitor.xcodeproj -scheme TokenUsageMonitor -destination 'platform=macOS,arch=arm64' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
